attr.title: Mute Crimson DX
attr.desc: Mute Crimson DX is an action-packed precision platformer where you guide Ninja on his quest to climb up walls, slice through bad guys and overcome great evils!
attr.inst: Buy and install the Linux version of Mute Crimson DX. Copy all the game assets to mutecrimsondx/gamedata
attr.inst_md:
1) Purchase the game from Steam  
2) Buy and install the Linux version of Mute Crimson DX. If you are using windows, use the following steam command: download_depot 2830430 2830432 1889794651090092114  
3) Copy all the assets to mutecrimsondx/gamedata  
4) Run Mute Crimson.sh. The first startup will patch the game to make it run on devices with 1GB RAM
